name: leaf-harmony-core-test
description: Runs Leaf's shared acceptance cases against harmony/entry/src/main/ets/core on Node. core/ is written in the ArkTS subset that is also TypeScript, so it compiles here without the HarmonyOS SDK.

scripts.test: node prepare.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test out/test/*.test.js && node arkts-lint.js
